_readme: NUMA's monthly and seasonal rhythm for Mobile, AL (Central time). strategy.py plan resolves each moment to dates for the planned month and attaches it to the slots it fits (local_seasonal slots get the seasonal moments; the week's sales post prefers an `offer` window). Dates are computed, never hard-coded per year: Mardi Gras = Fat Tuesday (Easter Sunday - 47 days); holidays by rule. Closures come only from the Closures Sheet / brand.json closures.known; a holiday here is flagged `possible_closure` so the Director checks it, never assumed closed. Payday timing is a hypothesis from the R2 research prompt, tested through the offer-week arm.

monthly.name: Month start (paydays)
monthly.what: Many people are paid around the 1st; a hypothesis for the week's offer post.

sources: docs/RESEARCH_PROMPTS_PLAYBOOK.md R2 (offers near paydays/month start, to be researched)
evidence.notes: Untested; the offer_week arm learns NUMA's own answer.

monthly.name: Mid-month (paydays)
monthly.what: Second common payday window; a hypothesis for an offer post.

seasonal.name: New Year reset
seasonal.what: New routines; the January 'cold start' offer window and first-timer content.
examples: New year, new routine: start with Discover NUMA.

sources: spec p.33 (New Year resets as a local moment)
research/1-content-benchmarks.md (batch-produce before peak seasons such as New Year)

seasonal.name: Cold snaps (sauna season)
seasonal.what: When the Friday forecast shows a cold front, swap in a weather hook ('Sauna season in Mobile').
examples: Sauna season in Mobile is open.

sources: research/1-content-benchmarks.md (Bathhouse 'Sauna season in NYC', 'defrost in the sauna')

seasonal.name: Mardi Gras season
seasonal.what: Mobile's Mardi Gras (two weeks of parades up to Fat Tuesday): a quiet-hour counterpoint and a recovery-week hook; parade days can affect hours and parking.
examples: Mardi Gras weekend? Here's your quiet hour.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (Mardi Gras recovery week, seasonal offer)

seasonal.name: Summer heat
seasonal.what: Gulf Coast heat: 'Too Hot for a DIY Plunge' (Mobile tap water rarely gets below 70°F) and heat-wave hooks.
examples: Mobile tap water in August? Not cold enough for a real plunge.
Summer heat? Start your first month inside.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (NUMA FAQ: tap water rarely below 70°F; summer heat reset offer)

seasonal.name: Hurricane season
seasonal.what: Atlantic hurricane season (June 1 to November 30): calm and community hooks; storms can close the studio, so check closures before anything that invites people in.
examples: Storm on the way? Our hours are in Stories.

evidence.notes: The season dates are NOAA's official Atlantic dates; the content angle is opinion.

seasonal.name: University of South Alabama terms
seasonal.what: Finals-week and back-to-campus angles for students and athletes; exact dates come from the university calendar, not this file.
examples: Finals week? Take one quiet hour.

sources: research/4-mobile-competitor-audit.md (USA students and athletes: finals-week reset, game-day content)
